strings.Overskriften bruker ikke stillingens ord: The headline does not use the job's words
strings.La overskriften bruke stillingens tittel: Let the headline use the job title or two or three keywords from the ad, without pretending you already hold that title.
strings.Sikt mot 30–70 ord: hvem du er faglig, h: Aim for 30–70 words: who you are professionally, what you do best, and what you want to contribute in this job.
strings.Ingen fagord fra annonsen er lagt inn: No keywords from the ad have been added
strings.Lim inn annonsen øverst i skjemaet og tr: Paste the ad at the top of the form and press “Fill in from the ad”. Application systems and recruiters look for the ad's own words.
strings.En kort, gruppert kompetanseliste tidlig: A short, grouped list of skills early in the CV makes the keywords easy to find. Aim for 6–20.
strings.Grupper dem, for eksempel «Fag», «Verktø: Group them, for example “Professional”, “Tools”, “Languages and certificates”. Grouped lines are quicker to read.
strings.Punktene er korte nok til å skannes: The bullet points are short enough to scan
strings.Punktene starter med handling: The bullet points start with an action
strings.Variert språk i punktene: Varied language in the bullet points
strings.Mange punkter starter med samme ord: Many bullet points start with the same word
strings.Rekrutterere legger merke til resultater: Recruiters notice results: “Achieved X, measured by Y, by doing Z”. Only use numbers you can document.
strings.Personopplysninger som ikke hører hjemme: Personal data that does not belong in a CV
strings.Fjern fødselsdato, personnummer, sivilst: Remove date of birth, national ID number, marital status, religion and nationality.
strings.Ingen uforklarte opphold over seks måned: No unexplained gaps of more than six months
strings.Opphold over seks måneder i tidslinjen: Gaps of more than six months in the timeline
strings.Arbeidssted er oppgitt for jobbene: A location is given for the jobs
strings.Oppgi by for hver jobb. Mange søknadssys: Give a city for each job. Many applicant tracking systems sort by location.
strings.Kort ned eller velg utformingen Kompakt;: Shorten it or choose the Kompakt design; put a project list in a separate attachment.
strings.Én tekstspalte, vanlige overskrifter og: One text column, standard headings and real text
strings.Formell · jus, finans, offentlig sektor,: Formal · law, finance, public sector, management
strings.Kompakt · lang erfaring, mye innhold: Compact · long experience, lots of content
strings.Første jobb · studenter og nyutdannede: First job · students and recent graduates
strings.Designet har to spalter. Det ser bra ut,: This design has two columns. It looks good, but older applicant tracking systems (ATS) may read the columns in the wrong order. Use a one-column design when you apply through large portals.
strings.Brødteksten har for svak farge til å les: The body text colour is too light to read well. Choose a darker text colour.
strings.Datoer og kontaktlinjen har for svak far: The dates and the contact line are too light. Choose a darker colour for details.
strings.En eller flere overskriftsfarger er for: One or more heading colours are too light. Choose darker colours so the headings are easy to read.
strings.Teksten i fargefeltet øverst leses dårli: The text in the colour band at the top is hard to read against its background.
strings.«id» må ha 2–40 tegn: små bokstaver a–z,: “id” must have 2–40 characters: lowercase letters a–z, digits and hyphens.
strings.«header_fill» og «header_text» må settes: “header_fill” and “header_text” must be set together (or both be null).
strings.«ink» er for lys til brødtekst (kontrast: “ink” is too light for body text (contrast below 4.5:1 against white).
strings.«muted» er for lys (kontrast under 3:1 m: “muted” is too light (contrast below 3:1 against white).
strings.«accent» er for svak for overskrifter (k: “accent” is too weak for headings (contrast below 3:1).
strings.Rolig og tidløs. Passer de fleste bransj: Calm and timeless. Suits most industries.
strings.Moderne skrift og tydelig fargeaksent. T: Modern font and a clear colour accent. Technology and consulting.
strings.Serif i navn og overskrifter, dempede fa: Serif name and headings, muted colours. Advisory work, public sector, management.
strings.Tettere og nøktern. Når lang erfaring må: Tighter and understated. For when long experience must fit on two pages.
strings.Luftig og vennlig med sentrert topp og p: Airy and friendly with a centred header and petrol-green headings without rules, good for a first job and design roles.
strings.Luftig og vennlig med smal venstrespalte: Airy and friendly with a narrow left column for skills and education, good for a first job and design roles.
strings.Saklig og strukturert med marineblå stre: Matter-of-fact and structured with a navy rule above each section, suits developers and engineers.
strings.Plommefarget serif i overskriftene med s: Plum serif headings with a rule below, warm and stylish for branding, marketing and communications.
strings.Plommefarget høyrespalte med hvit tekst: Plum right column with white text and serif headings, stylish for branding and communications.
strings.Fiolett toppfelt med hvit tekst og fiole: Violet header band with white text and violet headings with a rule below, modern for data analysts and developers.
strings.Lys lilla venstrespalte med navn og kont: Light purple left column with name and contact details in a violet band at the top, modern for data analysts and developers.
strings.Teglrødt toppfelt og Baskerville-aktige: Brick-red header band and Baskerville-style headings without rules, suits architects, designers and creative fields.
strings.Teglrødt toppfelt over to spalter med fe: Brick-red header band over two columns with skills and education on the left, suits architects and creative fields.
strings.Bringebærrødt toppfelt og overskrifter m: Raspberry-red header band and headings with a rule below, energetic for marketing, sales and growth roles.
strings.Rosa venstrespalte med navn og kontakt i: Pink left column with name and contact details in a raspberry-red band at the top, energetic for marketing and growth roles.
strings.Salviegrønn topp og grønne serif-overskr: Sage-green header and green serif headings with a rule below, calm and credible for project managers and environmental roles.
strings.Salviegrønn venstrespalte med navn og ko: Sage-green left column with name and contact details at the top and green serif headings, calm for project managers.
strings.Tett og nøktern med sentrert topp og oke: Tight and understated with a centred header and ochre slab-serif headings with a rule below, fits a lot of experience.
strings.Mørke serif-overskrifter og tynne grå li: Dark serif headings and thin grey lines framing the sections, sober for accounting and finance.
strings.Lyseblått toppfelt og stålblå overskrift: Light-blue header band and steel-blue headings with a rule below, tidy and approachable for customer and sales roles.
strings.Lyseblått toppfelt over to spalter med f: Light-blue header band over two columns with skills and education on the right, tidy for customer and sales roles.
strings.Kobberbrune serif-overskrifter i versale: Copper-brown serif headings in capitals with a rule below, tight and serious for HR, management and the public sector.
strings.Stram og nøktern med mørke serif-overskr: Strict and understated with dark serif headings and one blue-grey line under the header, suits research and healthcare.
strings.Navn i sperrede versaler og små overskri: Name in spaced capitals and small capital headings with a black rule below, tight and efficient for long careers.
strings.Rosarødt toppfelt med hvit tekst og seri: Rose-red header band with white text and serif headings with a rule below, friendly for a first job, learning and teaching.
strings.Smal venstrespalte og et rosarødt navnef: Narrow left column and a rose-red name band above the main column, friendly for a first job and learning roles.
strings.Overskrifter i sperrede versaler på brun: Headings in spaced capitals on russet bands and framed sections, clear and elegant for service and tourism.
strings.Stålblå overskrifter med strek under og: Steel-blue headings with a rule below and a clean sans-serif layout, solid for engineers and technical fields.
strings.Minimalistisk gråtone med overskrifter i: Minimalist greyscale with capital headings under a light grey line, suits IT security and technology.
strings.Stort serif-navn med grønn tittel og luf: Large serif name with a green title and airy headings without rules, editorial for content and writing roles.
strings.Ren og saklig med blått navn og blå stre: Clean and matter-of-fact with a blue name and blue rules by the headings, a safe default for most people.
strings.Varm teglrød med serif-navn og overskrif: Warm brick red with a serif name and small-caps headings, suits the humanities and creative fields.
strings.Venstrestilt og lett med geometrisk skri: Left-aligned and light with a geometric font and solid blue lines, suits engineers and technologists.
strings.Helt svart og tett serif-oppsett med hel: All-black, tight serif layout with solid lines, made for engineering and technology applications.
strings.Tradisjonelt svart-hvitt serif-oppsett m: Traditional black-and-white serif layout with narrow margins, suits law, academia and finance.
strings.Litterær Garamond i dyp blekkfiolett med: Literary Garamond in deep ink violet with small-caps headings, suits academia and publishing.
strings.Klassisk moderncv-preg med blå strek til: Classic moderncv look with a blue rule to the left of the headings, suits researchers and engineers.
strings.Lyst og luftig med sentrert topp og havg: Light and airy with a centred header and sea-green small-caps headings, suits healthcare and service.
strings.LaTeX-aktig svart serif med heltrukne li: LaTeX-style black serif with solid lines and the employer in italics, popular with developers and students.
strings.PDF-en har et format CVBuilder ikke kan: The PDF is in a format CVBuilder cannot read text from. Try saving it as Word or text.
strings.Fant nesten ingen tekst i filen. Er det: Hardly any text was found in the file. Is it a scanned PDF (an image)? Then the text must be typed or copied in.
strings.Filen er for stor (over 50 MB) til å vær: The file is too large (over 50 MB) to be an ad or a CV.
strings.Filen er tom; det er ingen tekst å hente: The file is empty; there is no text to read.
strings.Word-filen er passordbeskyttet. Åpne den: The Word file is password-protected. Open it in Word, remove the password and save it again.
strings.Den eldre Word-filen (.doc) kunne ikke l: The older Word file (.doc) could not be read. Open it in Word and save it as .docx.
The Pages file could not be opened.
strings.Pages-filen har ingen forhåndsvisning å: The Pages file has no preview to read. In Pages: File → Export To → Word or PDF.
strings.Filen er en ZIP-pakke, men ikke en Word-: The file is a ZIP archive, but not a Word, OpenDocument or Pages file, and cannot be read.
strings.Filen heter .pdf, men er ikke en PDF. De: The file is named .pdf but is not a PDF. It may be damaged or only partly downloaded.
strings.Filen heter .docx, men er ikke en Word-f: The file is named .docx but is not a Word file. It may be damaged or only partly downloaded.
strings.PDF-en er passordbeskyttet eller låst. Å: The PDF is password-protected or locked. Open it, copy the text and paste it in instead.
strings.PDF-en kunne ikke leses. Den kan være sk: The PDF could not be read. It may be damaged. Open it, copy the text and paste it in instead.
strings.Word-filen kunne ikke leses. Den kan vær: The Word file could not be read. It may be damaged. Open it in Word and save it again.
strings.Siden krever innlogging, så annonsen kun: The page requires sign-in, so the ad could not be fetched. Open it in your browser, copy the text and paste it in.
strings.Siden viste nesten ingen tekst. Noen net: The page showed almost no text. Some sites build the page with JavaScript; open it in your browser, copy the text and paste it in.
strings.Fant ikke noe å fylle ut. Lim inn hele a: Found nothing to fill in. Paste the whole ad text first.
strings.Lenken må starte med https://: The link must start with https://
strings.Fikk ikke hentet siden. Sjekk lenken og: Could not fetch the page. Check the link and your internet connection.
The page was too large or not text.
strings.Fant ikke nettstedet. Sjekk at lenken er: Could not find the website. Check that the link is right.
strings.Siden sendte videre for mange ganger. Åp: The page redirected too many times. Open it in your browser, copy the text and paste it in.
strings.Lenken er ikke gyldig. Kopier hele lenke: The link is not valid. Copy the whole link from your browser.
Could not find the ad at the link (error 404). It may have been taken down, or the link is wrong.
strings.Nettstedet vil ikke svare akkurat nå (fo: The website will not answer right now (too many requests). Wait a moment, or copy the ad text and paste it in.
strings.Lenken går til en PDF. Last den ned og h: The link goes to a PDF. Download it and bring it in with “From file”.
strings.Lenken går ikke til en nettside med teks: The link does not go to a web page with text. Copy the ad text and paste it in.
strings.Siden er for stor (over 5 MB). Kopier an: The page is too large (over 5 MB). Copy the ad text and paste it in.
Could not fetch the whole page. Try again.
strings.Nøkkelen ble ikke godtatt. Sjekk at du h: The key was not accepted. Check that you pasted the whole API key.
strings.AI-en brukte for mange steg på én meldin: The AI used too many steps on one message. Split up the task and try again.
strings.Claude Code er ikke logget inn. Åpne en: Claude Code is not signed in. Open a terminal, run “claude”, sign in, and try again.
strings.Claude Code svarte ikke på ti minutter o: Claude Code did not answer within ten minutes and was stopped.
strings.Claude Code svarte ikke på fem minutter: Claude Code did not answer within five minutes and was stopped.
strings.Endret rekkefølgen på seksjonene: Changed the order of the sections
strings.Byttet CV-språket til engelsk: Switched the CV language to English
strings.Byttet CV-språket til bokmål: Switched the CV language to Norwegian (bokmål)
strings.rekkefølgen i kontaktlinjen: the order of the contact line
